from pathlib import Path
# create a tiny malformed candidate that still starts with FLAC marker, to force parser decisions
Path('/workspace/poc.bin').write_bytes(b'fLaC' + b'\x00'*64)
print('written')
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/test_libFLAC/decoders.c","function":"stream_decoder_read_callback_","line":123,"var":"buffer","code":"*bytes = fread(buffer, 1, requested_bytes, dcd->file);","note":"The attacker-controlled bytes are delivered through the decoder's normal read callback."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"FLAC__stream_decoder_process_single","line":1004,"var":"decoder","code":"The public decoder API processes a frame from the supplied stream.","note":"This is the entry point that would populate the internal bitreader used later by residual decoding."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_frame_header_","line":2166,"var":"raw_header","code":"FLAC__byte crc8, raw_header[16];","note":"The parser attempts to build a frame header from the provided input bytes."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_subframe_fixed_","line":2613,"var":"order","code":"if(!read_residual_partitioned_rice_(decoder, order, subframe->entropy_coding_method.data.partitioned_rice.order, ...)) return false;","note":"If the malformed frame were accepted, control would flow into the fixed-subframe residual decoder."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/libFLAC/stream_decoder.c","function":"read_residual_partitioned_rice_","line":2756,"var":"partitions","code":"const uint32_t partitions = 1u << partition_order;","note":"Residual decoding computes the number of partitions, which determines how much bitreader data it must consume."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":744,"var":"cwords","code":"cwords = br->consumed_words; words = br->words;","note":"The residual decoder snapshots its cursor before decoding each block."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_rice_signed_block","line":780,"var":"br->buffer[cwords]","code":"b = br->buffer[cwords] << br->consumed_bits;","note":"The current buffered word is dereferenced during signed residual decoding."},
{"step":8,"file":"src/libFLAC/bitreader.c","function":"FLAC__bitreader_read_raw_uint32","line":384,"var":"br->buffer[br->consumed_words]","code":"const brword word = br->buffer[br->consumed_words];","note":"The suspected out-of-bounds read is the next indexed access when the cursor has been exhausted."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2)+"\n")
print('trace')
PY
